member_names: National Institute of General Medical Sciences
title: Telomeric Amplicons Research at University of Washington
summary: This cluster revolves around the research of telomeric amplicons, a process or phenotype studied by Brewer Bonita J. at the University of Washington. The National Institute of General Medical Sciences funded Brewer Bonita J.'s work on this topic. The University of Washington is the institution where this research is taking place. The entities involved in this cluster are all related to scientific research, with a focus on genetics and medical sciences.
